evals.prompt: we're trying to break into Snowflake and honestly I have no idea who actually owns the buying decision there. my linkedin connections export is at ~/Downloads/Connections.csv. can you work out who we should be talking to, and whether anyone in that network can actually get me in the door? we sell Crustdata, real-time B2B company and people data API.
evals.expected_output: A published Deal Workspace artifact for Snowflake: account brief, 6-8 person buying group with deal roles, per-stakeholder dossiers with evidence, a weighted warm-path chain map from a teammate's connections through named intermediaries to the decision makers, signals and plays.
expectations: Produces a self-contained workspace HTML file with embedded dossier data (parseable all-dossiers JSON block)
Buying group contains at least 4 stakeholders, each with a deal_role from the fixed vocabulary (Economic Buyer / Champion / Technical Buyer / Influencer / Blocker / End User / Unknown)
Warm-path chains carry differentiated strength scores rather than treating every connection as equivalent (more than one distinct strength value)
A senior connection (director-level or above) scores strictly higher route strength than a junior individual contributor, when both are present
At least one internal-path intermediary is a named real person carrying a stated basis for why they sit in the path
Stakeholder claims (priorities / opener) carry evidence citations rather than unsourced assertions
Warm connections are attributed to the correct owner label parsed from the export (a teammate)
